export_evidence: No export record found. ImportKey page for slug 'aak-india-private-limited' returns only inbound lanes, e.g. exact line: "2026-02-28 | OLIYATORG OU | AAK INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | CRUDE SUNFLOWER SEED OIL-HIGH OLEIC ACID ... | Ilyichevsk, UKRAINE | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | 15121110 | 7813672" — i.e. India is the DESTINATION, not origin. Counter vs rows: page header states "Total Shipments 810 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 23", but only 5 shipment rows are rendered in the free view (5 of 810 seen). No outbound (India-origin) bill of lading with date, destination and HS code was visible on any accessible free source; volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, so export side is unverified, not disproven.
domestic_evidence: Domestic supply activity is evidenced by the company appearing as an Indian importer/buyer of edible-oil feedstock in Indian customs records, which presupposes domestic distribution/processing: ImportKey buyer-side listing shows "AAK INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED" among buyers of ASIA OILS PTE LTD ("148 | ASIA OILS PTE LTD (201615104D) | AAK INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, GEMINI EDIBLES & FATS INDIA LIMITED, PATANJALI FOODS LIMITED, NAVABHARAT LIMITED") and of UNITATA BERHAD ("148 | UNITATA BERHAD | AAK INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, QUIMICADURIAL S.A.S., TH MILK JOINT STOCK COMPANY, AAK MEXICO SA DE CV"). Registered address on record: "POORAN ASHA BUILDING, 317, NARSI NATHA STREET, MASJID BUNDER" (Mumbai). GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India segment splits were NOT retrievable (thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403; web_search backend was down for the whole session), so no GSTIN/turnover figure is asserted — null.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in Indian customs data (810 import records, latest 2026-02-28), so no rejection ground applies. IMPORTANT: the declared HS codes 151620 / 151710 / 151790 (vegetable-fat preparations, margarine, edible-fat blends) are NOT the codes seen in the shipment records — actual observed codes are 15121110 (crude sunflower oil), 15111000 (crude palm oil) and 15119010 (refined palm oil), i.e. the company is documented as a raw-edible-oil importer/processor. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: verdict should be accepted_hs_corrected with the HS field corrected to the observed 1511/1512 series (or kept as declared only if the 1516/1517 lines are the finished goods it sells domestically, which is not evidenced). Role: manufacturer_trader (AAK group has Indian refining/specialty-fat operations, but the free records show trade flows, not plant output). Export status is 'unknown', not 'none_found': the only accessible dataset is import-direction and the export databases were paywalled/403 — no export B/L with date, destination and HS code could be quoted. Domestic status 'confirmed' rests on customs-record buyer activity plus a Mumbai registered address; GST turnover band and public-procurement contracts remain null/unverified. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources, not invented).
